objective: Separate source evidence acquisition, relation expansion and optional SHACL-report effects on final answers and review guidance.

cohort.development: Existing24authored PENELOPE questions are consumed development;18source-present and6bundle-absent. Never relabel as heldout.
cohort.evaluation: New independent questions and source records remain to be defined and frozen before tuning; not authorized as a benchmark claim.

inputs: frozen A1 and B parent rankings
phase1_locator.resolver: scripts/graphrag_explicit_anchor.py; exact supported locator grammar only; not semantic interpretation
phase1_locator.anchor_off: Preserve common-budget-off-002 and its explicit startup-failure lineage; reuse completed artifacts.
phase1_locator.anchor_on: For resolved_unique prepend original anchor chunk to each A1/B saved top-eight parent list, stable-deduplicate and retain first8. All other statuses retain original base list with explicit locator status. Source_invalid does not certify valid evidence; existing source validation remains mandatory.
phase1_locator.downstream: C and E independently expand same newly packed B evidence using original adjacency/SQLite policies. D uses exact new C evidence and freshly executed scoped SHACL/Python report. No report-driven retrieval or repacking.
phase1_locator.budget: Frozen common-message-budget-v1 full4096/base3072/reportincrement1024 and byte caps, E5surrogate only, generator_ready=false.
phase1_locator.measure: Unchanged offline support scorer after outputs frozen; all24question keys perarm and every failure retained. Preserve before/after support and displaced evidence. No gold to runtime.
phase1_locator.interpretation: Locator injection and seed selection intervention shared across methods; gains are not graph-specific or free-form natural-language understanding.

arms.D: Exact C evidence plus scoped SHACL report

phase2_answers.optional_baseline: A1 may be retained as secondary comparator only if included in frozen budget and attempt count before calls.
phase2_answers.policy: No mandatory SHACL veto. Model may answer source-supported fields, qualify unknowns and identify specific review needs. Do not treat conformance as truth or missing selected context as source absence.
phase2_answers.report_schema: Use same report slot for all arms, null for B/C; D receives checker facts only. Freeze wording and compact report before execution; retain raw reports. No hidden reference labels.
output_fields: specific review requests with evidence pointers
metrics: Task answer agreement with frozen source reference; not external physical truth
Citation validity and applicability to answer statement
Schema failures, failed calls and unfinished responses separately
phase2_answers.review_request_scoring: Predeclare source-backed review criteria; distinguish automated checks from blinded human ratings. No claim of expert validation or improved human understanding without actual experts/users.
phase2_answers.failure_policy: Full planned denominators; missing/error responses are not silently dropped. Failed costs nonrefunded; no automatic retry. Original outputs never repaired from references.
prelaunch_gates: Explicit new paid budget and bounded attempt reservation; prior paid stop remains meanwhile
Actual-model tokenizer or verified conservative admission bound, chat framing and output reserve accounted; E5 diagnostics insufficient
Model/tool accessibility and source disclosure scope checked without exposing credentials
Independent methods and implementation review before experiment execution
Scorer tested on authored fixtures; no runtime scorer or answer repair

phase3_neptune.goal: Actual backend execution parity and measured operational properties only; do not equate DB choice with answer-quality treatment.
phase3_neptune.current_authorization: No resource creation until these are fixed. Local readiness work allowed.

later_work.schema_generation: Bounded tool/LLM draft diagnostic from source text/tables; pinned OpenOntologies capabilities and licenses first. Record executable failures and required semantic edits; no assume domain-expert conclusions.
later_work.change_management: Controlled schema/field/relationship change cases with equivalent Python/SQL; measure affected outputs, edits and regression outcomes, not unmeasured human labor.
later_work.demo: Show actual saved source, selected evidence, report and answer provenance; clearly label mock or unexecuted outputs.
later_work.deferred: SWRL/SHACL Rules action prescriptions until concrete source-backed action requirements exist.
